Nepal Weather Observation Forecast. Observing the daily weather for Maximum Temperature, Minimum Temperature and Rainfall/Snowfall in the crucial part of Nepal in a regular routine for Dipayal, Dadeldhura, Dhangadi, Birendranagar, Nepalgunj, Jumla, Dang, Pokhara, Bhairahawa, Simara, Kathmandu, Okhaldhunga, Taplejung, Dhankuta, Biratnagar, Jomsom, Dharan, Lumle, Jankapur, and Jiri. Also, include historical charts for monthly, quarterly and yearly.

About Nepal Weather data

Weather observation data provided by the Department of Hydrology and Metrological Forcasting Division of Nepal. Note: Rainfall unit is measured on mm. Trace: greater than zero, but is too small to be measured by standard units, (*): Previous record, (--): Data not available.
